  Scenario: AC14 A suite step that reads a service schema directly fails the pipeline scan (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a suite change adds a step that reads a service schema directly
    When the pipeline scans that change
    Then the pipeline scan fails the change and no service schema is read

  Scenario: AC15 The legal hold, durable clock, projection, event and data rules hold on the wave 1 services (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a hire purchase case has a RUNNING SERVICE_LEVEL timer and a legal hold is set on the case
    When the timer is read through GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId}/timers
    Then both clocks keep running while the legal hold is set and the hold is visible on the timer read
    Then the timer is a durable timer inside CaseWorkflow and the timer row is its P3 projection
    Then the breach is produced by rwb-case on rwb.case.events.v1 with gateway-bff as the inbox consumer
    Then each cross-service call is one hop with a 2 s timeout
    Then no TimerDue event is produced and no event, workflow history, log or evidence carries personal data

  Scenario: AC16 A retried or timed-out RecordAndApply activity writes nothing partial and raises the breach once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given RecordAndApply fails as one unit during the breach of a SERVICE_LEVEL timer
    When the activity is retried or times out
    Then the decision record, the timer projection and the outbox row are either all written or none is written
    Then the breach is raised once
